2026-07-28 10:23:00.796056 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796073 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796077 | controller |
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796082 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796086 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796089 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796093 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796096 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796100 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-28 10:23:00.796104 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
